idea-plugin.name: Risk Register Lint
idea-plugin.description:
16 rules: ten Art. 21(2) measures (a)-(j) plus owner, 1-5 score, treatment and 12-month review for Markdown risk registers

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Risk Register Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 16 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/nis2-risk-register-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/nis2-risk-register-lint

action.text: Risk Register Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run Risk Register Lint on the file in the editor
